Stage: Faith-based and community radio, for programming
What happens: Civic programming on water, health and jobs with Radio Rahma, Radio Salaam and Baraka FM (Catholic Archdiocese of Mombasa). These stations carry high trust among women, elders and faith communities; the campaign offers residents' call-ins and expert segments, with no candidate named and no paid political message.

Stage: Direct 2G bulk SMS and USSD, to up to 95,645 phone owners not online
What happens: Deployment of the SMS engine and the zero-rated USSD gateway (*[shortcode]#) through a licensed aggregator. Bypasses radio entirely by landing 160-character ward alerts directly onto voters' phones within minutes.

Stage: The stages, markets and PA caravans
What happens: PA caravans and stage champions at Kongowea, Marikiti, Majengo, Mtopanga, Chaani and the Likoni ferry approaches. Short Kiswahili jingles, verified policy addresses and live Q&A directly with the crowd.
300 ward captains with pre-loaded 45-second Kiswahili audio tracks, dispatched across estate, chama, stage and residents' WhatsApp groups for peer-to-peer sharing among youth, traders and households.
